description: Anatomically reviewed label schema for the Dataset501 model used by this pipeline
notes: Raw labels 1 and 3 are bone and are excluded from cartilage measurements.
Only raw labels 2, 4, and 5 are included in quantitative masks.
Raw label 2 is split automatically using the medial/lateral tibial cartilage centroids without deleting cartilage voxels.
This reviewed schema supersedes the incorrect anatomical names in the historical Dataset501 dataset.json.
